answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies takes part in the central body deciding university-wide strategy and structure.
Budget allocation falls under the chancellor's responsibility, not the portfolio for studies and teaching.
The vice president for studies is responsible for teaching and degree programmes, not faculty appointments.
The faculty council handles the affairs of a single faculty, whereas the vice president operates at the central university level.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes and advises on teaching, which matches the vice president for studies' exact portfolio.
The vice president for studies is explicitly responsible for examinations and therefore participates in the board deciding examination matters.
Internal research funding concerns faculty research projects, which is separate from the vice president's teaching and studies portfolio.
Rewriting module descriptions for a specific programme is a detailed working task outside the central leadership's frame-setting role.
The description states that decisions on laboratory equipment have no bearing on study programmes, placing this outside the vice president's remit.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a local operational task outside the central responsibility for degree programmes and teaching quality.
